source: Frozen Problems-only atlas v1. The two faces and an admissible meridional branch are given; finite reach is a separate condition.

cases.facts: Symbolic glass index, grazing entrance, emergence at perpendicular adjacent face. Use explicit common exterior and relative index m>1. No numerical outside index given.
cases.expect: In the one-sided incident limit sin(theta)=cot(alpha)=sqrt(m^2-1). m<sqrt(2) has a non-tangent exit in the limit; equality gives grazing emergence in the limit, never a verified crossing; m>sqrt(2) gives strict TIR at that limit.

cases.facts: Glass pipe index 1.36, air outside; model planar meridional end entry and side wall. Use an explicit air index of 1 for numerical controls.
cases.expect: nEntrance sin(theta_limit)=sqrt(nCore^2-nWall^2); strict wall TIR below the critical launch boundary for rays that reach the wall. Axial ray misses; grazing entry excluded. If threshold >=1 every open interior angle qualifies.

native.shape: v9 convex square Glass (0,0),(100,0),(100,100),(0,100) mm; air 1 outside; partialReflection false; single ray at x=-5 aimed to enter the left face at y=70; the top face is the adjacent wall. Surrogate section for A19. Brightness 0.08, preview-v1.
native.checks: Require complete, warning-free native run and face-41 entry, face-34 target. Compare first incidence and outgoing direction/branch at wall to Snell/specular predictions; require hit point on target away from vertices. No exact grazing launch, no equality witness, no finite-path generalization.

guards: symbolic exact boundary distinct from floating critical proximity
reject missing or contradictory facts and duplicate face IDs; no silent air default
